recommendation: Keep this focused source fix; it restores a previously applied WG decision after a later unrelated roadmap rewrite. Broader Diagnostics module wording should remain with its own tracker issues.
issue_request: FHIR-50524 is an Applied/Persuasive R6 Orders and Observations technical correction asking the Diagnostics module Developmental Roadmap to add the Specimen FMM level by saying broader use will help increase maturity from FMM3.
initial_application: The request was initially applied by commit 5338e0a6cf040dfd5489c9c985340798c50d6ca4, later merged through PR #3487 with Jira-cited merge commit 4d30cfcf44eb588ef6d586d69145491e1d87d975. That application changed the Specimen roadmap sentence to end with 'maturity from FMM3.'
additional_context: The active Diagnostics module page is in source/hierarchy.xml, and source/fhir.ini declares specimen=3. The broad FHIR-50920 Diagnostics module update preserved the FHIR-50524 wording, but later commit c7d1fdbfa9a59d9eed76e28e7be2661a7e6f2a4b for unrelated FHIR-50514 replaced the roadmap list and reintroduced obsolete 'currently at FMM=2' text. OO WGM minutes mention FHIR-50524 as accepted to update the roadmap as proposed; no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Changed source/diagnostics-module.html so the Specimen roadmap bullet again says wider use will help increase its maturity from FMM3, matching the Applied issue and the active fhir.ini FMM value.
source_changes: source/diagnostics-module.html: replaced obsolete Specimen roadmap text '(currently at FMM=2)' with 'from FMM3'.

related_jiras.note: The broader Diagnostics module update preserved the FHIR-50524 FMM3 wording before later edits changed the roadmap block again.
